from tomlkit import parse, dumps, to_inline_table, to_standard_table
from tomlkit.items import InlineTable, Table
from tomlkit.exceptions import ConversionError

doc = parse('[parent]\nkey = 1\n')
assert to_inline_table('parent', doc) is doc
assert isinstance(doc['parent'], InlineTable)
assert doc['parent']['key'] == 1
assert parse(dumps(doc)) == doc
assert to_standard_table('parent', doc) is doc
assert isinstance(doc['parent'], Table)
try:
    to_inline_table('missing', doc)
except ConversionError as exc:
    assert exc.key_path == 'missing'
else:
    raise AssertionError('Missing key must raise ConversionError')
print('Reference sanity checks passed: imports, document identity, conversion, values, roundtrip, missing-key error')
